title: Meyer’s 1870 and Mendeleev’s 1869 periodic papers in Das natürliche System der chemischen Elemente
version: Leipzig, 1895 collected reprint; original journal volumes not independently inspected
lineage: Later reprint of both articles; original 1869 and 1870 journal volumes and manuscripts were not independently inspected.

passages.note: Reprint pp. 9–12 / source PDF pp. 12–15: Meyer’s 1870 article, its table and recognition of Mendeleev.
Reprint pp. 18–19 / source PDF pp. 21–22: Mendeleev’s 1869 table and missing-element and weight-correction proposals.

file.method: Selected pages extracted with pdfseparate and pdfunite; each source/excerpt page pair was raster-compared at 60 dpi.
